subject: A single small Mercury planet as a warm gray rocky sphere with a restrained number of broad shallow craters and quiet painted shading
prompt:
Generate ONE new individual sticker in the exact illustrative style of the supplied original desktop sticker references. References are style only, not subjects to copy.
Art direction: hand-painted 2D casual-game illustration with restrained local contrast, warm mid-light colors, thin warm locally colored outlines, simple matte painted volumes, just two or three quiet same-hue shadow patches. Modest detail and small broad paint marks. Soft illustrative volume matching the reference artwork. No shiny 3D toy appearance, deep dark crevices, harsh light, or dense surface texture. Do not anthropomorphize objects.
Entire subject centered and fully visible with clear padding on all sides; a narrow clean white sticker-cut margin follows the silhouette. No scene, floor shadow, text, letters, brand or watermark.
Deliver a PNG with a TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND: empty canvas outside the sticker, actual alpha transparency.
Square canvas, target 512 x 512. Entire sticker visible with clear padding.
SUBJECT: A single small Mercury planet as a warm gray rocky sphere with a restrained number of broad shallow craters and quiet painted shading. Draw exactly one isolated planet, scientifically recognizable through its main color, atmospheric or surface pattern, and any inherent ring system. The supplied planet images are style references only; do not copy their planet, markings, palette arrangement or pose. No face, eyes, limbs, stars, moons, orbit lines, glow, space scene or extra objects. Use a simple readable circular silhouette, restrained broad painted detail and quiet same-hue shading. The complete sticker including its narrow clean white cut margin occupies about 78 percent of the canvas in its longest dimension, with comfortable true transparent padding on every side.
note: The initial exact prompt and references above produced the archived rejected v1. The selected master is the second ImageGen pass described in selected_edit.

selected_edit.prompt: Edit only the most recent Mercury sticker. Simplify the rocky surface substantially: keep exactly seven broad shallow craters of varied sizes, remove all tiny craters and dense mottling, and use only three quiet warm-gray painted shadow patches. Make the result matte, restrained and readable at small game-sticker size while preserving the circular sphere, warm gray palette, thin brown outline, narrow white cut margin, centered scale, generous transparent padding and real transparent PNG background. No face, stars, moon, orbit line, glow, text or extra objects.
